name: Lead Finder v2 Hardening + LinkedIn Plugin
description: Harden SMTP email validation pathway, build Chrome extension for human-in-the-loop LinkedIn profile injection, integrate both into a single coherent system. Replaces the shell-level validation with a real, testable foundation.

phases.label: Phase 0 — SMTP reality check
gates: At least 10 real leads from ~/lead-seeker/leads.db sampled
SMTP pathway executed end-to-end against 10 real + 5 invalid addresses
Honest report: which addresses were correctly classified, which were not, what errors occurred

tasks.title: Sample 10 known-good emails from ~/lead-seeker/leads.db
Sample 5 known-deliverable emails from ~/lead-seeker/track.db opens
Construct 5 known-invalid emails (deliberate bad domains, malformed)
Run the 20 addresses through the current SMTP pipeline
Report: what worked, what failed, root cause for each failure

phases.label: Phase 1 — SMTP validation hardening
gates: Manual override mechanism implemented and tested
SMTP pathway correctly classifies >= 90% of known-good and known-bad addresses
Per-validation result persisted with timestamp and method

tasks.title: Implement 2-probe validation flow (random + actual local-part)
Document validation_status enum in CONTRACTS.md (already done)
Persist validation_confidence, validation_method, validation_checked_at, validation_mx_host, validation_response, validation_latency_ms
Implement manual override: a contact marked 'I know this works' bypasses SMTP
Re-validate the 23 existing 'Okay to Send' contacts with 2-probe design (some are likely invalid)
Re-run the 20-address Phase 0 test and verify >= 90% accuracy with 2-probe design
tasks.notes: 2-probe design is correct; 5/5 invalid classified correctly. Real leads/opens are limited by the Spamhaus block on the probe IP (Outlook MX returns 550 even for valid addresses).

tasks.title: Add a 100-address stress test (mixed valid/invalid/catch-all)
Refactor for robustness: connection retry, graceful timeout, MX lookup fallback, sender rotation
Add POST /api/contact/{id}/manual-validate endpoint

phases.label: Phase 2 — LinkedIn plugin v1
gates: Extension loads unpacked on the user's premium LinkedIn Chrome profile
Click on /in/* page extracts name, current title, current company, location from Experience section (NOT headline)
Confirmation popup shows every extracted field, all editable, with 4-case match action
POST /api/inject/linkedin-profile persists to contacts table with linkedin_slug as unique key
Always show confirmation popup (no silent updates)

tasks.title: Chrome extension manifest.json with content script, popup, service worker
Content script: extract Experience section data (name, current title, current company, location, full history)
Popup UI: editable form, 4-case match radio, Send button
POST /api/inject/linkedin-profile endpoint in lf_server.py
Schema migration: contacts.linkedin_slug UNIQUE, contact_experience table
Name normalization + company fuzzy match (Levenshtein <= 3) helpers
4-case matching engine: same person+company / same person new company / new person same company / new person new company
Always-show confirmation popup (per user requirement)
Document deployment steps for ~/lead-finder/static/chrome-extension/ in PLAN.md

phases.label: Phase 3 — Plugin polish and audit
gates: Highlight-to-extract mode works on any selected text
Audit log viewable in lead-finder UI
is_manually_edited contact field exists and is_manually_edited=true contacts cannot be overwritten without explicit confirmation

tasks.title: Highlight-to-extract mode in content script
Audit log: every push records who/what/when/before/after to a separate table
Audit log UI: a section in the lead-finder admin view
is_manually_edited flag on contacts, block auto-overwrite unless user confirms

phases.label: Phase 4 — Integration and end-to-end test
gates: End-to-end test: 20 real LinkedIn profiles from existing Naval/Aerospace companies in the lead-finder session
Each injected contact is SMTP-validated by Session 1's pipeline
Export pipeline correctly flags validated vs unvalidated contacts
All three sessions have written a post-mortem to PLAN.md

tasks.title: Run end-to-end test with 20 real profiles
tasks.notes: 20/20 passed. See docs/SESSION_3_E2E_RESULTS.md. Used lead-seeker real profiles (10 existing / 3 new at existing / 3 new at new / 2 by slug / 2 discard) as JSON payloads to the same /api/inject/linkedin-profile endpoint the Chrome extension calls.

tasks.title: Verify SMTP validation status appears on plugin-injected contacts
tasks.notes: 3/3 lifecycle cases passed. Plugin push with no email -> NULL (correct). Plugin push with email -> NULL then validator writes full result. Existing contact updated with new email -> NULL then validator picks it up. See docs/SESSION_3_T42_RESULTS.md.

tasks.title: Verify export pipeline only includes validated contacts (or flags unvalidated clearly)
tasks.notes: Two bugs found and fixed. (1) /api/export/contacts/{session_key} was returning unvalidated contacts in violation of CONTRACTS.md §1. Fix in lf_server.py:2412-2471: default now filters to smtp_validation_status='Okay to Send' AND email_ready_for_export=1. Opt-out via ?include_unvalidated=1 for debugging. (2) Inject handler's update_existing path was setting is_manually_edited=1 on every push (patch_contact default). Fix in lf_server.py:3327: explicit is_manually_edited=0 in the patch. Both fixes verified — t4.1 (20/20), t4.2 (3/3), and t4.3 cases all pass. See docs/SESSION_3_T43_RESULTS.md.

tasks.title: Refactor and document the final system state
tasks.notes: Verified write_contact_validation() is the single source of truth for all 11 validation fields. Documented the one carve-out (inject handler resets to NULL when new email attached, lf_server.py:3364). Also fixed a second integration bug: inject handler's update_existing path now sets is_manually_edited=0 explicitly (was inheriting patch_contact's back-compat default of 1). Added docstrings inventory: all Session 2 public helpers are documented. Wrote docs/FINAL_REPORT.md (the integrated system reference). Added 'System Status' section to docs/PLAN.md. Made E2E test re-runnable with --reset flag.

cross_session_communication: Any session that needs to change CONTRACTS.md MUST post a flag to PLAN.md 'Open Questions' section and wait for the owner to resolve before proceeding.
